_doc: Which SWFs the FPS patch converts (tools/xml_fps_patcher.py, verified by tools/check_fps_patch.py).
convert=true: every timeline stretched by k, the largest whole factor with original fps * k <= target_fps (a cap),
all frame-number references in the SWF's bytecode rescaled at run time by skyui.util.FpsScale.

played_at: for libraries other SWFs import (ImportAssets): their symbols play at the importer's frame rate, so their k is computed from played_at instead of their own rate; check_fps_patch.py verifies it against every importer.
keep_shallow: sprite ids whose own timeline stays unstretched (1-frame marker) while every timeline nested in it is stretched and gets its own k marker.
convert=false: frame rate and timelines unchanged (code is still rewritten, with k = 1, because it may
drive clips of converted SWFs loaded into it).
exclude=true: built exactly as with ENABLE_FPS_PATCH=OFF (no FpsScale class, no rewrite, no marker); for
SWFs that must not be touched at all. Only valid for SWFs whose code drives no converted SWF's clips.
Every SWF the build produces must be listed here; the patcher refuses unknown SWFs.
enterframe_free_running: code locations whose onEnterFrame handlers are time-based (getTimer) and may run
every frame; all other onEnterFrame handlers are throttled to the original frame rate.
method_override_allowed: classes that define nextFrame/prevFrame/gotoAndStop/gotoAndPlay themselves but
are not MovieClips (FpsScale.go passes calls on non-MovieClip objects through unchanged).

hudmenu.swf.reason: sprite 387 (Compass Marker, 152 frames) is an icon atlas addressed by frame number; Map Marker Framework, DbSkseFunctions, ShowUnlooted and SkyBuild read and extend its raw frame layout from native code, so its own timeline stays unstretched

skyui/bottombar.swf.reason: imported (ImportAssets) by the item menus at 60 fps; its symbols play at their rate

skyui/configpanel.swf.reason: imported (ImportAssets) by quest_journal.swf at 30 fps; its symbols play at that rate

skyui/itemcard.swf.reason: imported (ImportAssets) by the item menus at 60 fps; its symbols play at their rate

gfxfontlib.swf.reason: font library, one frame, nothing animates

skyui/buttonart.swf.reason: static art library (one frame per button, picked by label); nothing plays

skyui/mapmarkerart.swf.reason: static art library (map marker icons); nothing plays

skyui/icons_category_celtic.swf.reason: static icon library (gotoAndStop by label); nothing plays

skyui/icons_category_curved.swf.reason: static icon library (gotoAndStop by label); nothing plays

skyui/icons_category_psychosteve.swf.reason: static icon library (gotoAndStop by label); nothing plays

skyui/icons_category_straight.swf.reason: static icon library (gotoAndStop by label); nothing plays

skyui/icons_item_psychosteve.swf.reason: static icon library (gotoAndStop by label); nothing plays

exported/skyui/icons_effect_psychosteve..reason: static icon library (gotoAndStop by label); nothing plays

compat._doc: Compatibility profiles, chosen with the CMake option FPS_PATCH_COMPAT (comma separated; empty for none). Each overrides "swfs" entries so that other mods which read SkyUI's raw frame numbers keep working. SWFs loaded into a converted menu play at their own frame rate (checked in game), so an unconverted SWF inside a converted host animates at its normal speed.

morehud_inventory.why: AHZmoreHUDInventory.as reads the item card's _totalframes and _currentframe and compares them with fixed frame numbers (AHZCCSkyUIFrames: MAX_FRAMES 221, EMPTY 151, ...). A stretched item card makes every comparison fail.

skyui/itemcard.swf.reason: compat morehud_inventory: the ItemCard symbol (249) keeps its original 221 frames because moreHUD Inventory Edition reads its raw frame numbers; the animations nested in it are stretched

keep_timelines._doc: Sprites (and everything nested in them) left unstretched inside a converted SWF because the game engine drives them by frame number from native code, which the patcher cannot rewrite. Each gets its own 1-frame __fpsScale marker so ActionScript sees k = 1 for them.

hudmenu.swf.714: StealthMeterInstance.SneakAnimInstance (120 frames): handed to the engine by RegisterHUDComponents, which sets the stealth eye by frame number
hudmenu.swf.820: EnemyHealth_mc.BracketsInstance (100 frames): handed to the engine by RegisterHUDComponents, which sizes the enemy-name brackets by frame number

enterframe_free_running.init __Packages.mx.transitions.Tween: time-based when constructed with useSeconds=true; check_fps_patch.py requires every 'new Tween(...)' to pass a literal true
enterframe_free_running.init __Packages.com.greensock.TweenNano: time-based (getTimer) unless useFrames is set; check_fps_patch.py rejects useFrames outside TweenNano itself

method_override_allowed.init __Packages.mx.transitions.Tween: Tween.nextFrame/prevFrame step the tween, Tween is not a MovieClip
